# Lingroo

Lingroo is an independent web application and installable PWA for German learners at B2 and C1 level.

## Core product facts
- Main application: https://www.lingroo.de/
- Public information site: https://www.lingroo.app/
- Price: EUR 4.99 per month
- Full trial after registration: 14 days
- Billing: monthly; cancellation before the next billing period
- Interface: German
- Vocabulary support: Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and English
- Speaking practice: in development, not currently sold as a finished feature

## Current content library
- 997 vocabulary entries: 298 B2 and 699 C1
- 750 contextual synonym tasks: 250 B2 and 500 C1
- 320 gap and language-structure tasks
- 80 reading texts with 450 questions
- 40 listening materials with 200 questions
- 30 writing topics: 15 B2 and 15 C1
- 14 short writing exercises: 6 B2 and 8 C1
- 6 original exam-mode training sets: 3 B2 and 3 C1

## Access model
A broad part of B2 practice is open during the current test phase. Free C1 access is limited to selected samples. A registered tester receives full access for 14 days; Premium continues full access afterwards.

## Important limitation
Lingroo is not affiliated with telc, Goethe-Institut or TestDaF. Its training sets are original Lingroo materials and are not official examination papers.
